ios.desc:
Wreflecto Square is a fun addictive brain-training word puzzle game featuring two unique gameplay modes. Based on the ancient Sator Square, which is sometimes called the World's oldest word puzzle, this game challenges you to think strategically and symmetrically. Daily challenges and unlimited on-demand play help exercise your vocabulary and logical reasoning skills.

TWO UNIQUE WORD SQUARE GAMES
- Master Wreflecto Mirror: unique daily puzzles where you create symmetrical word squares.
- Challenge yourself with Wreflecto Cross: demanding daily puzzles where you build intersecting word grids.
- Choose between 4x4 and 5x5 grid sizes for varying difficulty levels.
- Get instant validation feedback with checkmarks for correct words and X marks for invalid entries.
- Reveal solutions to study winning strategies and improve your skills.

OFFLINE ACCESS & UNLIMITED ON-DEMAND GAMEPLAY
- Play anywhere, anytime. No internet connection required for on demand mode.
- Perfect for airplane mode, flights, long commutes, waiting rooms, or areas with poor connectivity.
- Puzzles, archives, and statistics work seamlessly offline.
- Play unlimited puzzles in On Demand mode.
- Multiple difficulty levels to match your current skill and mood.

DAILY BRAIN TRAINING & CHALLENGES
- Solve fresh daily puzzles that keep your mind sharp and engaged.
- Build consistent brain-training habits with new challenges every day.
- See past daily challenges in comprehensive archives. Never miss a puzzle.
- Choose the perfect time for daily puzzle notifications.
- Track your solving streaks and celebrate consistent play.

COMPREHENSIVE PROGRESS TRACKING
- Monitor your improvement with detailed statistics and completion rates.
- View advanced metrics showing your puzzle-solving patterns and progress over time.
- Celebrate achievements and see how your strategic thinking evolves.
- Track performance across both Mirror and Cross game modes.
- Easy one-click sharing results with friends and other players.

PERFECT FOR
- Word puzzle enthusiasts looking for unique, challenging gameplay beyond traditional crosswords.
- Brain training seekers who want daily mental exercise and cognitive improvement.
- Strategy game lovers who enjoy logical thinking and pattern recognition challenges.
- Students and professionals sharpening their vocabulary and problem-solving skills.
- Commuters seeking engaging, offline entertainment for travel time.
- Gamers interested in games similar to Scrabble, Boggle, Wordle, NY

quotes.text:
Wreflecto is a word square puzzle where every row and every column must form a valid word. Read more about ancient word squares here - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sator_Square

Unlike crossword or wordle, there are many possible solutions. Any valid word combination works. 4x4 (easy) on weekdays. 5x5 (hard) on weekends. Two modes - mirror (https://wreflecto.com/mirror), and cross (https://wreflecto.com/cross).

Daily puzzle is free on web. Built using vanilla JS/HTML/CSS, everything runs in the browser, no backend, no ads, no account/login.

Also turned it into an iOS game with both daily and on-demand unlimited play offline: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6751056949

Please let me know if you try it.
